key_provisions_or_claims: Removed best practice of notifying controlling organisations before web-scraping
Organisations relying on Publicly Available Exception behind digital barriers must document reasoning in a DPIA or written record
AI-Specific Notifications clarified as flexible; apply only where deemed consent and consent exceptions do not apply
Multiple stakeholder roles require policies to meet each set of obligations
Agent-specific data issues deferred to separate study and guidance
named_instruments_referenced: Advisory Guidelines on Use of Personal Data in AI Recommendation and Decision Systems
annotation.summary_en: Singapore PDPC's response to feedback on its proposed Advisory Guidelines on personal data use in generative AI. It summarises 43 submissions and explains revisions on the Publicly Available Exception, AI-specific notifications, stakeholder responsibilities, and access and correction obligations. It defers agentic AI data issues to later guidance.
annotation.title_clean: Response to Feedback on Public Consultation on Proposed Advisory Guidelines on Use of Personal Data in Generative AI
